notes.title: Update 1.3.0 is here!
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/21110552/a0c966c2ce70e495c5c95c98da63e25b95a96a03.png[/img]Good day everyone,

we're here to bring you an early present: you get 1GB free drive space!

We added compression support to our game engine, so all that data needs much less space on disk. After downloading, [b]On Rusty Trails[/b] is now occupying a mere 500 megabytes. Of course, all the content is still there, it's just more tightly packed and loads up even faster!
The only downside is that this patch is much bigger than the previous ones, because you basically have to redownload the whole thing. Future updates will be back to a few megs, though.

Complete list of changes:
[list]
[*] Added compression for game files, which reduces disk usage from 1.7GB down to about 500MB
[*] Added multi-threaded asset loading, which improves loading times
[*] Improved controls menu, each input can now be mapped to multiple buttons or keys
[*] Added Xbox 360 controller prompts (from https://opengameart.org/content/free-keyboard-and-controllers-prompts-pack)
[*] Fixed a bug which caused controls settings not to be saved
[*] Fixed minor localization issues
[*] Steam account name and avatar are now shown in the main menu
[*] Updated Steamworks SDK to 1.41
[*] Updated libSDL to 2.0.7
[/list]

notes.title: Patch 1.2.0 released
notes.content:
Greetings, dear players,

Today we pushed update 1.2.0 out. We added translated text for Chinese and German, as well as a lot of optimizations. Enjoy!

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/21110552/a69d765b4e4bc275dc36f51a38f0e8d3fc74598e.png[/img]

List of changes:
[list]
[*]Added localized text for Chinese (both simplified and traditional) and German
[*]On low quality settings, the most expensive post FX are now disabled to improve frame rates on low-end graphics cards
[*]Optimized render state management, which improves performance, especially on low-end CPUs
[*]Optimized task management, which positively impacts performance and battery usage
[*]Fixed a very rare crash which happened after switching to a new level
[*]Fixed stuttering of intro video
[*]Minor improvements to loading times
[*]Fixed a few minor bugs detected by UBSan
[*]Updated Steamworks SDK to 1.40
[/list]

Windows only:
[list]
[*]Windows XP is now supported
[/list]

macOS only:
[list]
[*]Enabled usage of SSSE3 CPU instructions (previously used SSE2 only). Probably no gain in performance because of this, but it can't hurt, either.
[/list]

Linux only:
[list]
[*]Removed dependency on libGL.so, all GL functions are now dynamically loaded
[/list]

notes.title: Patch 1.1.3 released
notes.content:
Hey there,

here's another patch that addresses a technical problem on older CPUs like the Core 2 Duo.

There's a change for Windows users in this update, that [i]might[/i] break the game in some rare cases. We moved the EXE from a sub-directory to the game directory, so you can start the game from outside Steam. This wouldn't work previously, because the game couldn't find the data files when run from the sub-directory.
So if the game fails to launch, make sure the update has downloaded correctly. You may have to restart Steam so it will receive the latest configuration.
If the error persists, there are two things you should know:

[list]
[*]If you previously copied or moved the game files to the main directory yourself, this could clash with the update. In this case, you will get an error message that says "Write error" when launching the game.
[*]If you don't download the update, you can't run the game from Steam anymore, because it will expect the EXE to be at the new location. There will be an error message that says "Missing executable".
[/list]

Let's hope for a smooth update - here goes nothing :)

notes.title: On Rusty Trails v1.1 is here!
notes.content:
Hey nice people of this fine group,

today, we released a major update for On Rusty Trails which contains a few long-awaited features and bug-fixes.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/21110552/e881e2ff9ff193b751598872ba3246672a61308e.jpg[/img]

A list:
[list]
[*] Leaderboards can now be viewed from the level select menu (press Y on controller or L on the keyboard)
[*] Level select screen now shows the status of each completed level (completed without dying / completed while keeping all tokens)
[*] Added replay level button (Back on controller, Backspace on keyboard) when at the stats screen after each level
[*] Final boss fight was broken when it was started again after watching the credits
[*] Fixed an issue where cutscenes would no longer skip on request when changing levels frequently
[*] Removed a render target texture that wasn't even used, saves a bit of memory
[*] Fixed a bug where gravity wasn't reset correctly after player died inside a force field
[*] Player deaths are now counted only if a save point was used, otherwise they are reset on respawn
[*] Fixed a file handle leak which could cause problems during loading on macOS
[/list]

We hope you enjoy this early holiday present! For those of you who are into speed-running, the retry button and in-game leaderboards should be up your alley. And if you are hunting achievements, the level select badges make that much less frustrating...

There's a lot more to be done, so expect many more updates to come, and see you all next year!

Have a good one,
the team at Black Pants

EDIT: There was a game-breaking bug introduced by this patch, but it's now resolved in the current version.
